text: Great sesh, fam. Real ones come to office hours.
note: A soft, gentle whisper right into the mic, proud of saying fam; the room's PA makes it boom. Say 'real ones' clearly.
Whispered, warm, delighted, into the mic. Clean read, exactly these words.
Barely moving his lips, low, certain, like a funeral.

text: It says hours. Plural. That's a suggestion.
note: Easy, packing up, completely sure, a little amused.
Flat, quiet, like a warning.
Light, curious.
A beat of unease, then brisk, changing the subject, leaving. Say every word clearly, including the last word, five.
Flat, under his breath, refusing what he sees. Long cut only.

text: I did not RSVP to that.
note: Quiet, betrayed, offended, stressing RSVP.

text: Just go in, baby. It's faster.
note: Warm older woman, unbothered, mopping, not looking up.
Very calm, kind, slow, soft.
Insisting, a little too fast, still sure he is leaving.
Nodding, kind, completely at peace.

text: Did they ever drop the new GTA?
note: Gentle, hopeful, like it's nothing.
Soft, kind, he cannot do it to him.
Delighted, warm, still soft, no mic now.
Nervous, gentle, soft.
Very small, hopeful and scared of the answer, his lip trembling.
Soft, a beat of giving in; he cannot say no to this man.
A whisper, moved to tears, overwhelmed.
Hopeful, bright, soft.
Normal, a bit annoyed, on the pitch.
Flat, hollow, a man who has seen things.
Flat and calm, passing the doom on to his friend, deadpan with the smallest smile.
